implementation.name: original-v4-two-link-singularity
implementation.scope: Planar kinematic snapshots, fixed speed magnitude along each posture current weakest direction, not a fixed Cartesian vector or timed trajectory.
implementation.question: Why does the same tool speed demand faster joints?

purpose: Expose velocity ellipse collapse and individual joint-rate cost as the original elbow straightens.
storyboard: Map joint rates to the velocity ellipse
guard: The demand direction rotates with posture. Norm is not a per-joint rate. Feasible speed meets only instantaneous velocity limits; it is not a safety certificate.
